name: File Checksum
summary: Compute MD5, SHA-1, or SHA-256 of any file in your browser — verify against an expected digest.
description: Drop or choose a file to hash locally with MD5, SHA-1, or SHA-256. Copy the digest, toggle uppercase, and optionally compare to an expected checksum. File bytes never leave your device.

faqs.question: Is my file uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Hashing runs entirely in your browser using local algorithms.

faqs.question: Which algorithms are available?
faqs.answer: MD5, SHA-1, and SHA-256. Prefer SHA-256 for integrity checks; MD5/SHA-1 remain useful for legacy verify workflows.

faqs.question: How does compare work?
faqs.answer: Paste an expected digest (spaces or colons are ignored). The tool reports whether it matches the computed hash.
